2608.16798.title: ClawGym II: Exploring Black-Box RL on Agent Harness
2608.16798.paper_summary: Agent harnesses have substantially improved performance on long-horizon tasks by coordinating agent interactions with the environment. However, reinforcement learning through complex harnesses remains largely unexplored, as scaling such training to long-horizon agent tasks introduces fundamental challenges. In this work, we present a unified black-box RL framework for stable and scalable optimization of general agents through complex harnesses. Concretely, we first build a sandbox-based execution infrastructure that isolates task environments and harnesses within temporary sandboxes for large-scale concurrent rollouts. We then decouple policy optimization from opaque harness execution and place a serving proxy at the model boundary to capture model calls. To reconstruct multi-turn trajectories and improve training efficiency, we organize the captured calls into prefix trees and further adapt both critic-based PPO and critic-free GRPO to optimize over the recovered tree structure. Meanwhile, we maintain training-inference consistency throughout the optimization process. Finally, we introduce mix-harness training, allowing a single model to be jointly optimized by heterogeneous harnesses. With Qwen3-30A3B, black-box RL improves Pass@1 on ClawGym-Bench by 9.98 and 14.81 points through OpenClaw and Claude Code, respectively, while remaining stable over 200-400 optimization steps. Moreover, the framework yields consistent gains on more challenging tasks such as JobBench and OfficeQA. Overall, our framework enables effective, stable, and scalable optimization of general agents through black-box harnesses, supporting unified training across heterogeneous execution systems.
2608.16798.paper_summary_zh: 代理人驅動的系統通過協調代理與環境的互動，顯著提升了在長期任務上的表現。 然而，通過複雜的驅動系統進行強化學習仍然在很大程度上未被探索，因為將這種訓練擴展到長期代理任務會帶來根本性的挑戰。 在這項工作中，我們提出了一個統一的黑箱強化學習框架，用於通過複雜的驅動系統進行穩定且可擴展的一般代理優化。 具體來說，我們首先建立了一個基於沙盒的執行基礎設施，將任務環境和驅動系統隔離在臨時沙盒中，以便進行大規模的並發展開。 然後，我們將策略優化與不透明的驅動執行解耦，並在模型邊界放置一個服務代理以捕獲模型調用。 為了重建多輪軌跡並提高訓練效率，我們將捕獲的調用組織成前綴樹，並進一步調整基於評論者的PPO和無評論者的GRPO，以在恢復的樹結構上進行優化。 同時，我們在整個優化過程中保持訓練與推理的一致性。 最後，我們介紹了混合驅動訓練，允許單個模型通過異質驅動系統進行聯合優化。 使用Qwen3-30A3B，黑箱強化學習通過OpenClaw和Claude Code分別提高了ClawGym-Bench的Pass@1 9.98和14.81點，同時在200-400次優化步驟中保持穩定。此外，該框架在更具挑戰性的任務如JobBench和OfficeQA上也產生了一致的增益。 總體而言，我們的框架通過黑箱驅動系統實現了一般代理的有效、穩定和可擴展的優化，支持在異質執行系統之間的統一訓練。
